title: Authentication Architecture Guide
content: Authentication requests pass through the identity gateway, session validator, and policy engine. SSO uses SAML assertions while OAuth login uses signed access tokens. Check gateway logs before changing identity-provider settings.

title: Enterprise SSO Setup
content: Configure the SAML audience, assertion consumer URL, signing certificate, and group mapping. A mismatch between the configured audience and assertion recipient causes a generic login rejection.

title: OAuth Login Guide
content: OAuth authorization code flow exchanges a short-lived code for tokens. Validate redirect URIs exactly and rotate client secrets without overlapping invalid credentials.

title: AUTH-431: SSO Group Mapping Failure
content: AUTH-431 occurs after enabling SSO when the identity provider sends group names with different letter casing than the configured application mappings. Enable case-insensitive group matching or normalize the IdP group claim, then refresh the user's session.

title: AUTH-502: OAuth Clock Skew
content: AUTH-502 occurs after OAuth login when a node clock differs from the identity provider by more than 60 seconds. Synchronize the application nodes with NTP and retry after existing tokens expire.

title: Refund Policy (Archived 2024)
content: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days. Annual plans are refundable after cancellation by contacting support. This policy was superseded on January 1, 2026.

title: Current Refund Policy (Effective 2026)
content: The current policy provides a full refund within 14 days of the initial purchase. Renewals and consumed usage are not refundable. Enterprise exceptions require billing-team approval.

title: Renderer 4.1 Release Notes
content: Renderer 4.1 introduced partial GPU batching and retained legacy font fallback. Known issue: large SVG assets can exceed the render timeout.

title: Renderer 4.2 Release Notes
content: Renderer 4.2 added adaptive GPU batching, a new font fallback engine, and streaming SVG parsing. It removes the large-asset timeout documented in 4.1.

title: Incident 101: Checkout Latency
content: Checkout latency increased when the tax service exhausted its connection pool. Increasing the pool masked the issue; bounded retries and circuit breaking resolved it.

title: Incident 102: Duplicate Checkout
content: Duplicate orders were caused by clients retrying after a gateway timeout without an idempotency key. Require an idempotency key for every checkout creation request.
